body.zh-Hant: 桂太郎生於弘化4年11月28日（西曆1848年1月4日），山口縣出身，父親是萩藩士。他從軍參加戊辰戰爭，明治3年（1870年）赴德國留學；明治8年以德國公使館附武官身分再度赴歐，從事德國軍政的調查研究，明治11年回國。
body.en: Katsura Taro was born on the 28th day of the 11th month of Koka 4 (4 January 1848 in the Western calendar) in Yamaguchi Prefecture; his father was a retainer of the Hagi domain. He served in the Boshin War, went to study in Germany in Meiji 3 (1870), returned to Europe in Meiji 8 as military attache at the German legation to study German military administration, and came home in Meiji 11.

citations.quote: 生没年 弘化4年11月28日 〜 大正2年10月10日
出身地 山口県
父は萩藩士。戊辰戦争に従軍。明治3(1870)年ドイツ留学。
8年ドイツ公使館付武官となり再び渡欧。
11年に帰国後、
ドイツの軍政の調査・研究に従事。

body.zh-Hant: 回國後，桂太郎在山縣有朋之下推動兵制與陸軍官制改革；明治19年任陸軍次官，甲午戰爭時任第3師團長。其後歷任第2代臺灣總督、東京防禦總督，並在第3次伊藤內閣出任陸軍大臣，之後在第1次大隈、第2次山縣、第4次伊藤各內閣留任。1901年6月2日，他自己組閣出任首相。
body.en: After returning home Katsura carried out reforms of the army system and army administration under Yamagata Aritomo, became vice-minister of the army in Meiji 19, and commanded the 3rd Division in the Sino-Japanese War. He then served as the second governor-general of Taiwan and as governor-general of Tokyo defence, became army minister in the third Ito cabinet and stayed on in the first Okuma, second Yamagata and fourth Ito cabinets. On 2 June 1901 he formed his own cabinet as prime minister.

citations.quote: 山県有朋 の下で兵制・陸軍官制の改革を行う。
19年陸軍次官。日清戦争では第3師団長。

body.zh-Hant: 桂太郎與西園寺公望輪流擔任首相（桂園時代）：第1次桂內閣自1901年6月2日至1906年1月7日，第2次桂內閣自1908年7月14日至1911年8月30日。第2次內閣期間他自己兼任大藏大臣。國立國會圖書館的解說寫道，他主導了日英同盟的締結、日俄戰爭與日韓併合；之後以元老身分出任內大臣。
body.en: Katsura alternated with Saionji Kinmochi as prime minister (the Katsura-Saionji era): his first cabinet ran from 2 June 1901 to 7 January 1906 and his second from 14 July 1908 to 30 August 1911. In the second cabinet he also held the finance portfolio concurrently. The National Diet Library note says he led the conclusion of the Anglo-Japanese Alliance, the Russo-Japanese War and the annexation of Korea, and later served as Lord Keeper of the Privy Seal as a genro.

body.zh-Hant: 桂太郎於1912年12月21日組成第3次桂內閣，在職僅62天，至1913年2月20日；官邸頁面列他兼任外務大臣，1913年1月29日起由加藤高明接任。國立國會圖書館的解說稱，他再度出任首相後因憲政擁護運動而下臺。他於大正2年10月10日（1913年10月10日）去世。
body.en: Katsura formed his third cabinet on 21 December 1912 and held office for only 62 days, until 20 February 1913; the cabinet page lists him as concurrent foreign minister, with Kato Takaaki taking over from 29 January 1913. The National Diet Library note says that after becoming prime minister again he fell because of the Constitutional Protection Movement. He died on 10 October 1913.

body.zh-Hant: 毛拉（Antonio Maura y Montaner）1853年5月2日生於馬約卡島的帕爾馬，1925年12月13日卒於馬德里。他到馬德里讀法律，結識加馬索（Gamazo），這份交情後來成為姻親，也幫他開啟律師與政治生涯。他26歲便以馬約卡代表身分進入議會，這個選區此後一直支持他；1886年任眾議院副議長。
body.en: Antonio Maura y Montaner was born in Palma de Mallorca on 2 May 1853 and died in Madrid on 13 December 1925. He went to Madrid to study law and met Gamazo, a friendship that later became a family tie and eased the start of his legal and political career. At 26 he entered the Cortes for Mallorca, a constituency that stayed loyal to him, and in 1886 he became vice-president of the Congress.

body.zh-Hant: 1892年12月，毛拉在薩加斯塔內閣出任殖民地（Ultramar）大臣，為古巴提出有限自治方案，但遭西班牙國內反對，薩加斯塔又未全力支持，他在1894年3月辭職。1894年底他重回內閣掌司法部，至1895年3月；1902年12月在西爾維拉（Silvela）的保守黨內閣任內政大臣，但在1903年7月離開政府。
body.en: In December 1892 Maura took a portfolio in Sagasta's cabinet as minister for the colonies (Ultramar) and proposed limited autonomy for Cuba; the plan was opposed in Spain and Sagasta did not back him loyally, so he resigned in March 1894. At the end of that year he re-entered the cabinet as minister of justice, holding the post until March 1895, and in December 1902 he became interior minister in Silvela's conservative cabinet before leaving power in July 1903.

heading.zh-Hant: 語言學院院長與首次任首相

body.zh-Hant: 1903年11月29日起毛拉擔任皇家語言學院院長。1903年底他再度執政並出任首相，任職到1904年12月。
body.en: From 29 November 1903 Maura was president of the Royal Spanish Academy. At the end of 1903 he returned to power as president of the council, holding the post until December 1904.

citations.quote: Dal 29 novembre 1903 fu presidente della R. Accademia spagnola.
Lo riassunse però alla fine dello stesso anno,
come presidente del consiglio, per tenerlo sino al dicembre 1904.

body.zh-Hant: 1907年1月起，毛拉主持新的保守黨內閣：以行政改革回應地方分離傾向，準備海軍武備方案，並為壓制恐怖攻擊而加嚴既有法律。梅利利亞戰事失利與巴塞隆納「悲劇的一週」之後，他堅持處決費雷爾，議會轉而反對其政策，他便退出政壇。第一次世界大戰期間他重返首相職位，被稱為中立派政黨的首領（1917至1918年）；1921年再度執政。普里莫·德里維拉上臺後，他的政治生涯告終，1925年12月13日在馬德里去世。
body.en: From January 1907 Maura led a new conservative ministry that answered separatist tendencies with administrative reform, prepared a naval armaments plan and made the existing laws stricter to suppress terrorist attacks. After the defeats at Melilla and the Tragic Week in Barcelona he insisted that Ferrer's death sentence be carried out; the Cortes turned against his policy and he withdrew from political life. During the world war he returned to the presidency of the council and was described as head of the neutralist party (1917-18); he governed again in 1921. Primo de Rivera's coming to power ended his political career, and he died in Madrid on 13 December 1925.

body.zh-Hant: 威廉·馬克思（Wilhelm Marx）1863年1月15日生於科隆，信奉天主教。他1881至1884年在波昂讀法律，1888年通過第二次國家考試；1894年任埃爾伯費爾德地方法院法官，1904年升科隆地方法院法官，1907年任杜塞道夫高等法院法官。他在埃爾伯費爾德加入中央黨，1899至1904年主持該黨的地方組織。
body.en: Wilhelm Marx was born in Cologne on 15 January 1863 and was a Catholic. He studied law in Bonn in 1881-84 and passed the second state examination in 1888; he became a regional court judge in Elberfeld in 1894, a regional court councillor in Cologne in 1904 and a higher regional court councillor in Düsseldorf in 1907. He joined the Centre Party in Elberfeld and chaired its local association in 1899-1904.

legte 1888 die Zweite Juristische Staatsprüfung ab.

1904 Landgerichtsrat in Köln,
1907 Oberlandesgerichtsrat in Düsseldorf
M. trat in Elberfeld dem Zentrum bei; 1899-1904 stand er dem Ortsverband vor.

heading.zh-Hant: 議員與天主教學校運動
heading.en: Legislator and the Catholic school movement

body.zh-Hant: 馬克思1899至1921年先後屬普魯士眾議院與邦議會，1910年起進入帝國議會，其後也是國民議會議員，直到1932年。1911年他創立跨黨派的天主教學校組織；1917年支持帝國議會的和平決議，1919年6月說服中央黨團接受凡爾賽條約，1921年7月15日的宗教子女教育法也是他在文化政策上的成果。
body.en: Marx sat in the Prussian House of Deputies and later the Landtag in 1899-1921, and in the Reichstag and National Assembly from 1910 to 1932. In 1911 he founded the non-partisan Catholic School Organisation; in 1917 he backed the Reichstag peace resolution, in June 1919 he persuaded the Centre group to accept the Versailles treaty, and the law on the religious education of children of 15 July 1921 was the most visible result of his cultural-policy work.

body.zh-Hant: 1921年9月27日馬克思成為中央黨國會黨團主席，1922年1月17日升任黨主席。1923年11月30日他接掌由人民黨、巴伐利亞人民黨、中央黨與民主黨組成的少數內閣，1923年12月8日取得授權法，貨幣改革創造了「地租馬克奇蹟」。1924年4月16日他的看守內閣接受道威斯專家報告。1925年他曾短暫出任普魯士總理；中央黨推他為總統候選人，他在4月26日以1370萬票對1460萬票輸給興登堡。
body.en: On 27 September 1921 Marx became chairman of the Centre Party's Reichstag group and on 17 January 1922 chairman of the party. On 30 November 1923 he took over a minority cabinet of DVP, BVP, Centre and DDP, and an enabling act of 8 December 1923 gave him extraordinary powers; the currency reform brought the 'miracle of the Rentenmark'. On 16 April 1924 his caretaker cabinet accepted the Dawes experts' report. In 1925 he briefly served as Prussian minister-president; the Centre Party nominated him for Reich president and he lost to Hindenburg on 26 April by 13.7 to 14.6 million votes.

heading.zh-Hant: 司法部長、再任總理與卸任黨魁
heading.en: Justice minister, second chancellorship and end of party leadership

body.zh-Hant: 1926年1月，馬克思在第2次路德內閣出任司法與占領區部長。該內閣倒臺後，興登堡於1926年5月17日再度任命他為總理；1926年12月17日他因國會失敗而辭職，其後領導納入民族人民黨的右派內閣。興登堡於1928年6月29日解除他的總理職務；他在1928年12月8日辭去黨主席。
body.en: In January 1926 Marx became Reich minister of justice and for the occupied territories in Luther's second cabinet. After that cabinet fell, Hindenburg appointed him chancellor again on 17 May 1926; he resigned on 17 December 1926 after a defeat in the Reichstag and then led a right-wing coalition that included the DNVP. Hindenburg relieved him of the chancellorship on 29 June 1928, and on 8 December 1928 he gave up the party chairmanship.

body.zh-Hant: 卸下黨主席後，馬克思於1932年放棄國會議席，退出政壇；他在1925年曾獲波昂大學神學榮譽博士，1946年8月5日在波昂去世。
body.en: After giving up the party chairmanship, Marx renounced his Reichstag seat in 1932 and retired from politics; he had received an honorary doctorate in theology from Bonn in 1925, and he died in Bonn on 5 August 1946.
